 integral_0^t A(s)*exp(-4pi^2*nu*((l^2+1)*(t-s)+l^2*s))ds.
For ANY nonnegative smooth pulse of actionS=int_0^tau A(s)ds,

where c_(p,l)=||sin(2pi*y)cos(2pi*l*z)||Lp(T3)>0 is explicit and independentS.
